item.title: Humphrey Orjiakor: US Concentrates Effort WhereTransaction Is Most Profitable
item.description: Nigeria's former permanent representative at the UN in Geneva, Humphrey Orjiakor, says Nigeria may be losing US diplomatic priority.

item.title: Messi Regrets Not Learning English Earlier Despite Illustrious Career
item.description: Lionel Messi says he regrets not learning English as a child, saying it left him unable to communicate with global figures.

item.title: Ex-NNPC General Manager Okoronkwo Sentenced To More Than 7 Years In US Over $2.1m Bribe
item.description: US court has sentenced former NNPC General Manager Paulinus Okoronkwo to over 7 years in jail for $2.1m bribe.

item.title: Jerry Ohikere: Lack Of Trust In Healthcare System Is Driving Nigerians Abroad
item.description: International Management and Health System Expert Jerry Ohikere says Nigerians seek medical care abroad due to distrust in local hospitals.

item.title: Tinubu Tasks IGP Disu To Lead Police Firmly, Restore Public Confidence
item.description: President Tinubu has decorated Olatunji Disu as Acting IGP, urging fairness, professionalism and renewed fight against insecurity.

item.title: Nigeria Omitted As Pope Leo Unveils 2026 African Tour
item.description: Pope Leo plans to visit Algeria, Angola, Equatorial Guinea and Cameroon, but will skip Africa’s most populous nation, Nigeria.

item.title: Oil Prices Hover Near Seven-Month Highs Amid US–Iran Tensions
item.description: Oil prices hovered near a seven-month high on Wednesday as Middle East tensions and US–Iran talks fuel supply disruption fears.

item.title: EFCC: CBN Board Approved AMCON Takeover Of Arik Air
item.description: EFCC tells a court that CBN authorised Arik Air takeover as trial over alleged N76bn fraud continues.

item.title: Coroner Fixes April 14 For Inquest Into Death Of Chimamanda Adichie’s 21-Month-Old Son
item.description: Lagos Coroner’s Court has fixed April 14 for the commencement of an inquest into the death of Chimamanda Adichie’s son.

item.title: CBN Interest Rate Cut Draws Cautious Praise From Private Sector
item.description: Members of the Organised Private Sector have praised CBN’s 50bps interest rate cut but warn lending conditions remain tight.
